review_scope: All 35 unique external operators in the embedded Version 8 alignment overlay, including the CJ-UEJ supporting-component mapping.
claim_policy: A scoped semantic match documents comparable intent; it does not make a provider executable, close an external gate, or authorize an accepted product claim.

entries.scope: CJ-UEJ-001 supporting-component profile diagnostics with disclosed x/D, y/D, probe/source uncertainty, and profile sampling.
unresolved_differences: This is not a primary VIS product operator mapping.
The component claim remains proposed and unaccepted.

entries.scope: Combined line-of-sight and field-of-view sensor-space radiance; the external claim is not intrinsic source J_lambda.
unresolved_differences: The committed operator is typed for the optical ray-transfer product; extending it to the SIG target requires an explicit product contract.
Current providers do not expose the required observer pose, FOV, atmospheric path, and sensor-response scenario.

entries.scope: Mach-disk axial position versus chamber pressure, with branch-aware treatment of the unordered hysteretic point cloud.
unresolved_differences: Current visual providers emit display channels and no mach_disk_position_m channel.
The bounded construction endpoint is not a physical Mach-disk endpoint.

entries.scope: Sample a model spectrum onto the declared sensor grid and then compare peak-normalized relative shape.
unresolved_differences: The current spectral probe has no overlap with the external UVVIS curve and only partial overlap with the FTIR curve.
The pipeline does not provide source calibration or absolute radiant-intensity validation.

entries.scope: Compare source-plus-path line-of-sight spectral shape after declared LOS/FOV transfer, sensor sampling, and peak normalization.
unresolved_differences: Current optical probes are analytic or synthetic fixtures and are not bound to the external EMAP observer/path scenario.
The current spectral probe has no overlap with the external UVVIS curve and only partial overlap with the FTIR curve.

entries.scope: Ray-to-surface band-integrated radiative heat flux after declared surface geometry and gauge response.
unresolved_differences: The current band-integral helper is a spectral-array reduction and does not supply a time-dependent surface pose, view factor, or Gardon response.
The provider comparison is not executed because the corpus observation is a time history rather than a spectral curve.

entries.scope: Band-integrated detector response and formulation trend, without promoting the result to a resolved spectrum.
unresolved_differences: The committed operators do not encode the ALSI formulation sweep, calibration, or detector-specific response asset.
The corpus record is a band-integrated thermal table without a spectral curve, so the current spectral probe is not executed.

entries.scope: Band-integrated image/ray reduction for projected total power.
unresolved_differences: No single committed operator preserves the external image-area lineage, detector response, and projected-power semantics together.
The projected-area signature operator is source-only and cannot be substituted automatically.

entries.scope: Alignment of pressure and radiation histories in a supporting unsteady-state study.
unresolved_differences: The committed registry has no temporal alignment operator that preserves the source time bases and cross-sensor lineage.
This is supporting capability evidence, not a primary VIS, SIG, or RAY product gate.

entries.scope: Alignment of model snapshots to a time-dependent chamber-pressure trace.
unresolved_differences: No committed operator declares interpolation, clock synchronization, or snapshot-to-trace uncertainty for this supporting capability.

entries.scope: Crossflow-driven curved-plume centerline component evidence.
unresolved_differences: A support envelope is not a crossflow field or a centerline-deflection solver.
The current visual product is straight-axisymmetric and does not expose the required ambient-flow field.

entries.scope: Conservative support/deflection envelope after an explicitly supplied ambient-flow field.
unresolved_differences: The internal support-envelope operator does not create the ambient velocity field or curved centerline response.
No current provider supplies the crossflow scenario or deflection uncertainty.

entries.scope: Visible-window particle-velocity event counts using declared bins, detection limits, and event semantics.
unresolved_differences: The current repository has no particle-state provider or L2F measurement asset.

entries.scope: EMAP material, feedstock, propellant, and formulation scenario configuration.
unresolved_differences: Scenario configuration is not a measurement operator and has no committed equivalent in the operator registry.

entries.scope: Controlled aluminum-to-silicon formulation sweep selection.
unresolved_differences: The committed registry has no formulation-sweep scenario operator or composition model.

entries.scope: EMAP hot-fire case linkage, nozzle, co-flow, and throat-restriction scenario selection.
unresolved_differences: Scenario selection is upstream of product measurement and is not represented by a committed measurement operator.

entries.scope: Published one-dimensional chamber, throat, and nozzle-exit state selection.
unresolved_differences: The current provider contracts do not encode the external nozzle-state asset or its source-condition lineage.

entries.scope: RETALT hot GH2/GO2 plume and freestream operating-condition selection.
unresolved_differences: No committed scenario-definition operator represents the RETALT run selection and provenance.

entries.scope: Rotor geometry, RPM, thrust coefficient, and ground-effect scenario selection.
unresolved_differences: The exhaust-plume operator registry has no rotor/ground-effect scenario equivalent.

entries.scope: Comparison of source-published equilibrium thermochemical context.
unresolved_differences: Source-equilibrium context is a model/scenario comparison, not an implemented product measurement operator.

entries.scope: Transmission, optical depth, or path-averaged extinction at declared wavelengths and path geometry.
unresolved_differences: The current gray provider exposes homogeneous transfer but no corpus-backed extinction or soot-density scenario.
The external record is supporting optical-medium evidence, not accepted RAY product validation.

entries.scope: Named unsteady feature frequency with declared sample rate, window, reference scale, and feature definition.
unresolved_differences: Current visual providers are steady and emit no time history or frequency channel.

entries.scope: Symmetric/antisymmetric frequency and mode feature extraction from a declared time or phase record.
unresolved_differences: The current visual lane has no transient provider, mode metadata, or frequency output.

entries.scope: Pressure-dependent Mach-disk location extracted from an explicitly supplied local flow field.
unresolved_differences: The internal feature operator accepts the semantic feature but no local-field provider or branch-aware field output is implemented.

entries.scope: Axial shock-feature phase and spacing extracted from a declared local-flow field and coordinate frame.
unresolved_differences: Current visual providers expose display geometry only and no local-field shock-feature channel.

entries.scope: Scalar visible extinction or equivalent source-radiance envelope as a plausibility diagnostic.
unresolved_differences: The transmissometer operator does not by itself produce source radiance or a conservative plume envelope.
The current gray provider is not a corpus-backed visible-extinction scenario.

entries.scope: Particle kinematics affecting residence time and optical emission.
unresolved_differences: Projected-area integration is not a particle-kinematics or residence-time operator and cannot be substituted automatically.
No particle trajectory or emission-coupling provider is implemented.

entries.scope: Particle-size population contribution to absorption, emission, and scattering.
unresolved_differences: Particle collection is a population measurement operator, while projected-area summation is a source-only ray reduction; neither represents particle optical properties or scattering.

entries.scope: Reported extrema or hazard envelope using a declared statistic, time window, sensor identity, and ambient subtraction policy.
unresolved_differences: The current registry operator defines the reduction semantics but no ambient-wake field provider or full-scale sensor data are present.

entries.scope: PIV sampling coordinates and jet-on/jet-off state definition.
unresolved_differences: The PIV-plane operator consumes a declared plane and vectors; it does not select the external sampling locations or experimental state.

entries.scope: Normalized radial outwash profiles sampled at declared stations and normalized with a disclosed reference.
unresolved_differences: The committed profile-probe semantics are compatible, but no ambient-wake field provider or external station geometry is implemented.

entries.scope: Collected particle-size distribution after the declared probe position, exposure, treatment, and weighting convention.
unresolved_differences: No particle population provider or corpus-backed collection protocol is implemented.

entries.scope: Sensor-resolved base pressure coefficient with disclosed sensor pose and normalization.
unresolved_differences: The internal sensor-array contract is broader than this pressure-only record and no external base-pressure scenario is implemented.

entries.scope: Black Brant flight/motor/atmosphere/observer/spectral-imager case definition and sensor integration.
unresolved_differences: LOS/FOV spectral radiance and the FPA expected-electron adapter are separate partial operators; neither captures the complete imager case and calibration lineage.

entries.scope: Water-cooled model-base thermal response with disclosed surface pose, response model, and cooling assumptions.
unresolved_differences: The internal sensor-array operator does not implement conjugate heat transfer, coolant response, or the external model-base asset.
